# Launch plan

This plan covers the **Q3 launch** of the review tool. It is a draft and will change.

## Goals

We want to reach 500 weekly active teams by the end of the quarter. We want to keep support tickets low.

- Ship the Markdown viewer
- Ship the prompt compiler
- [ ] Publish to the store
- [x] Choose a license

> [!WARNING]
> The store review can take up to two weeks.

## Timeline

| Phase | Start | End |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Beta | July 1 | July 20 |
| Launch | August 4 | August 4 |

The launch date is fixed. We want to keep support tickets low.
